WITH velocity AS (
  SELECT ff.item_key, SUM(ff.qty_shipped) AS units
  FROM mro_distributor.o2c_fulfillment_line ff
  GROUP BY ff.item_key
),
cutoff AS (
  SELECT quantile_cont(units, 0.2) AS q FROM velocity
),
item_supplier AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT po.item_key, po.supplier_key
  FROM mro_distributor.p2p_purchase_order_line po
),
fast_movers AS (
  SELECT v.item_key, 'fast_moving' AS group_type
  FROM velocity v, cutoff
  WHERE v.units > cutoff.q
),
slow_movers AS (
  SELECT v.item_key, 'slow_moving' AS group_type
  FROM velocity v, cutoff
  WHERE v.units <= cutoff.q
),
combined_velocity AS (
  SELECT item_key, group_type FROM fast_movers
  UNION ALL
  SELECT item_key, group_type FROM slow_movers
)
SELECT
  cv.group_type,
  AVG(po.late_days) AS avg_supplier_late_days,
  COUNT(DISTINCT po.supplier_key) AS supplier_count,
  COUNT(*) AS po_line_count
FROM combined_velocity cv
JOIN item_supplier m ON cv.item_key = m.item_key
JOIN mro_distributor.p2p_purchase_order_line po USING (supplier_key, item_key)
GROUP BY cv.group_type
ORDER BY avg_supplier_late_days DESC;

      WHEN late_shipment = 1 AND short_shipment = 0 THEN 'Late Only'
      WHEN late_shipment = 0 AND short_shipment = 1 THEN 'Short Only'

    COUNT(*) * 100.0 / SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER () AS pct_of_total
